question: Should the staged-proof architecture and Administration-scoped ruleset-verifier rollout land together after rebase and exact-head validation?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent, but coupling the validation redesign with a new repository App permission and privileged finalizer rollout is an operational choice that requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Approve integrated rollout
options.body: Resolve the conflict, rerun exact-head checks, confirm the App permission, and land the complete fail-closed design together.

options.title: Stage privileged rollout
options.body: Land the proof architecture while keeping ruleset-backed automated merging disabled until permission and live workflow behavior are separately confirmed.

options.title: Split the branch
options.body: Separate proof staging from privileged finalization if maintainers prefer smaller independently deployable changes.

recommendation.title: Approve integrated rollout
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict, rerun exact-head checks, confirm the App permission, and land the complete fail-closed design together.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current validation implementation and the proposed integrated trust-chain design, with Peter Steinberger as the strongest adjacent repair-lane reviewer.
